# [TASK] Make /audit-artifacts usable and discoverable from Antigravity

## Task
Make `/audit-artifacts` usable by Antigravity, not only by Claude Code.

The files already reach Antigravity: `.agents/skills` is a symlink to
`.claude/skills`, so `.agents/skills/audit-artifacts/SKILL.md` resolves.
Two things stop it being usable.

1. `audit-artifacts` appears 0 times in `AGENTS.md`. No autonomous run,
   Claude Code or Antigravity, is told the skill exists. `/resync-tasks` is
   listed under Issue hygiene; this one is not.
2. The Parallelism section offers only the Claude Code `Agent` tool.
   `AGENTS.md` step 4 of the work loop names both options ("a subagent in
   Claude Code, a separate agent run in Antigravity"). The skill should
   match that, and should state that its `tools:` frontmatter lists Claude
   Code names that other tools ignore.

## Parent Story
No parent. Contract and tooling change with no user-facing slice. Follows
#254, which added the skill.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `AGENTS.md` names `/audit-artifacts` with both paths, the way it
      already does for `/resync-tasks`
- [x] The skill's Parallelism section names the Antigravity option as well
      as the Claude Code one
- [x] The skill states how to invoke it without slash commands, and that
      it needs only `gh`, `git` and file access
- [x] `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/CLAUDE.md` still resolve to `AGENTS.md` as
      symlinks after the edit

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
Edit `AGENTS.md` only. `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/CLAUDE.md` are symlinks to
it and must not be replaced with copies.
